comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
Hi there, 
First you are on Reddit, you have to expect the worst here. If your game looks anything like ai you will get destroyed for it, even in this community or especially (?)

About the game, the idea for an immersive world is there but we can tell it's one of your first projects and there is nothing bad about it. It's just not finished in any way or form. 
I leaned it the same way you do now, by getting bashed for it. 

Take one asset of your game for example a tree or a character and continue to iterate until it looks awesome and then go and do it for the rest of the game. 

For the next time, don't present it as 'look what I build' but rather, 'any advice how to make it better?' 
You re talking to Devs or wannabe devs.
 they are neither your friends nor your market, but your best critique. 

If you get bashed on Reddit, best to not reply! Especially not defensive. 

The point: anyone here can recreate what you did, there is nothing special there yet. It could be though...
